sentiment.rationale: Maersk raised its full-year 2025 underlying EBIT guidance from $0-3bn to $2-3.5bn and underlying EBITDA guidance from $6-9bn to $8-9.5bn, a material upward revision. The raise is attributed to more resilient market demand outside North America and a strong first-half performance, not to one-time items or FX. Management language is confident, citing strong execution and successful Gemini cooperation launch, though they acknowledge ongoing geopolitical uncertainty and a cautious view on Q4.

summary.revenue: Q2 2025 consolidated revenue of USD 13.1bn, up 2.8% year-on-year (USD 12.8bn in Q2 2024).
summary.eps: Q2 2025 earnings per share of USD 38 (USD 51 in Q2 2024).
summary.guidance: Full-year 2025 underlying EBITDA raised to USD 8.0-9.5bn (previously 6.0-9.0), underlying EBIT raised to USD 2.0-3.5bn (previously 0.0-3.0), free cash flow raised to -1.0 or higher (previously -3.0 or higher). Global container market volume growth revised to 2-4% (previously -1% to 4%).
summary.margin: Q2 2025 EBITDA margin 17.5% (16.8% in Q2 2024), EBIT margin 6.4% (7.5% in Q2 2024), underlying EBIT margin 6.2% (5.9% in Q2 2024).
key_risks: Unprecedented geopolitical volatility and low visibility into macroeconomic factors.
Continued pressure on loaded freight rates due to supply-demand imbalance.
Uncertainty around US trade policy and tariffs.
Red Sea disruption expected to last for the full year, adding costs.
North America logistics revenue down 8% year-on-year.
Logistics & Services EBIT margin still below 6% target.
key_opportunities: Successful Gemini cooperation phase-in with >90% schedule reliability and cost savings on track.
Strong volume growth in Ocean (4.2% YoY, 10% sequential) and Terminals (9.9% YoY).
Terminals record-high volumes and ROIC of 15.4% well above 9% target.
Logistics & Services EBIT margin improving to 4.8% (up 1.3pp YoY).
More resilient market demand outside North America driving guidance raise.
China's industrial exports providing a new driver for container demand.

management_tone.label: confident
management_tone.justification: Management describes 'solid performance,' 'strong execution,' and 'excellent performance' across segments, and raised guidance with language like 'we are well prepared to manage these ongoing challenges.'
